non_english: Bonjour, monsieur. And now, if you please, we will go on in English.
Ah, bonjour, madame! You find me at home, as you see.
Mon ami, you must not take it so much to heart.
Merci, monsieur, but I will not trouble you further.
Buon giorno, signor. You are welcome, though I have no more Italian than that.
Si, senor -- there, my Spanish is spent.
Mein herr, you will forgive me if I go no further in German.
Adieu, then, and mind you come back to plain English next time.
